The '''''Solar Flare''''' was a modified [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class medium freighter]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It saw heavy usage throughout the war, and was at one stage used by a group of Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] who attempted to set up a Rebel cell in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]]. Its modifications included changes to the weaponry, as well as reduced cargo capacity but increased passenger space.

==History==
The ''Solar Flare''' was owned by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The ship saw many [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of use by the Rebels, with five different [[Captain/Legends|captains]] commanding the ship over a two year period at one stage, each pushing the vessel to its limits. [[Alliance High Command/Legends|Alliance High Command]] assigned the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] to a group of Rebel [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] trying to establish a cell in the [[Tapani sector/Legends|Tapani sector]] shortly after the organization's [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|battle]] against the Empire on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. By this time the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was heavily modified, but also tended to often break down due to years of wear.<ref name="LotE" />

==Layout and modifications==
The ''Solar Flare'' was [[Barloz-class medium freighter/Legends|''Barloz''-class medium freighter]] produced by the [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian Engineering Corporation]]. The ship stood at forty-one [[Meter/Legends|meters]] in length, and required a skeleton crew of one, but would normally be crewed by four individuals, two of whom were gunners. By the time of its use in the Tapani [[Sector/Legends|sector]], the vessel had been heavily modified, with its crew quarters expanded to take six passengers along with the four crew, and also including an entertainment area. The area included a [[Hologame table/Legends|hologame table]] with over fifty [[Hologame/Legends|hologames]], a [[Holovid/Legends|holovid]] player and physical workout equipment, all for recreational use. The vessel was capable of carrying a reduced one hundred [[tonn]]es of cargo as well as two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] worth of consumables, and was built to maintain three hundred and thirty to nine hundred and fifty atmospheres of pressure.<ref name="LotE" />

The ships armaments and systems had also been modified, with its [[Concussion missile launcher/Legends|concussion missile launchers]] being reduced from the quad normal for the model down to only a dual unit. This was to allow for the addition of a tower-mounted [[Quad turbolaser cannon/Legends|quad turbolaser cannon]]. The launchers made use of [[PL-8 Piercer Missile]]s, of which it was carrying eight when it entered the Tapani sector. The [[Power generator/Legends|power generators]] for both the missile launchers and the turbolaser both were added at the cost of space previously used for cargo, hence the reduced capacity. The vessel's systems included both a [[Navigation computer/Legends|navigation computer]], a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], and a sophisticated countermeasures package.<ref name="LotE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Solar Flare'' was first mentioned in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]'', a supplement for ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]'' released in [[1997]] by [[West End Games]]. The supplement, which was written by [[Paul Sudlow]] and [[Chris Doyle]], provided the ''Flare'' as a vessel for player characters with a Rebel alignement who started the campaign without a ship of their own.
